records.name: Classical Riemann Hypothesis
records.domain: nontrivial zeros of the classical Riemann zeta-function
records.quantifiers: for every nontrivial zero rho
records.normalization: xi(s)=1/2 s(s-1) pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) zeta(s)
hypotheses: standard meromorphic continuation and zero taxonomy
records.conclusion: Re(rho)=1/2
records.claim_boundary: No package in WP01/WP02 proves or disproves this target.

records.name: Analytic continuation, completion, and functional equation
records.domain: zeta, Lambda, xi on the complex plane
records.quantifiers: all complex s away from declared poles before completion
records.normalization: WP00 function-and-zero lock
records.conclusion: zeta extends meromorphically with a simple pole at 1; xi is entire and xi(s)=xi(1-s).
records.claim_boundary: Does not locate nontrivial zeros on the critical line.

records.name: Zero taxonomy, symmetry, and critical-strip location
records.domain: zeros of zeta and xi
records.quantifiers: every zero, with multiplicity
records.normalization: trivial zeros are negative even integers; nontrivial zeros are xi zeros
records.conclusion: nontrivial zeros lie in 0<Re(s)<1 and occur under conjugation and rho↦1-rho symmetry.
records.claim_boundary: Symmetry permits off-line quartets and is not RH.

records.name: Riemann–von Mangoldt zero-counting interface
records.domain: N(T), nontrivial zeros with 0<Im(rho)≤T
records.quantifiers: admissible T not equal to a zero ordinate unless endpoint convention is supplied
records.normalization: zeros counted with multiplicity; fixed upper endpoint convention
records.conclusion: N(T)=T/(2pi) log(T/(2pi e))+O(log T), with explicit refinements available under stated ranges.
records.claim_boundary: Counting all zeros does not by itself count those on the line.

records.name: Published explicit zero-free regions near Re(s)=1
records.domain: zeta(sigma+it) for |t| above stated thresholds
records.quantifiers: all points in the source regions
records.normalization: natural logarithms; source thresholds and constants retained
records.conclusion: No zeros in sigma≥1-1/(55.241(log|t|)^(2/3)(loglog|t|)^(1/3)) for |t|≥3, and no zeros in sigma≥1-1/(5.558691 log|t|) for |t|≥2.
records.claim_boundary: These regions stay near Re(s)=1 and do not squeeze every zero to Re(s)=1/2.

records.name: Guth–Maynard zero-density estimate
records.domain: N(sigma,T), zeros with Re(rho)≥sigma and |Im(rho)|≤T under the source convention
records.quantifiers: fixed sigma in the source range as T→∞
records.normalization: T^{o(1)} convention from the source
records.conclusion: N(sigma,T)≤T^{30(1-sigma)/13+o(1)}.
records.claim_boundary: A density bound allows exceptional zeros and is not RH.

records.name: More than five-twelfths of zeros lie on the critical line
records.domain: nontrivial zeros ordered by height
records.quantifiers: liminf as T→∞
records.normalization: kappa=liminf N0(T)/N(T), identical multiplicity and height conventions
hypotheses: unconditional mollified-moment estimates in the source
records.conclusion: kappa>5/12.
records.claim_boundary: A positive proportion, even density one, does not exclude exceptional off-line zeros.

records.name: Certified finite-height verification
records.domain: nontrivial zeros with 0<Im(rho)≤3·10^12
records.quantifiers: all zeros in the stated finite-height interval
records.normalization: interval arithmetic and source zero-count completeness conventions
hypotheses: verified implementation and source certificate chain
records.conclusion: Every zero in the interval lies on Re(s)=1/2 and is simple.
records.claim_boundary: No conclusion is supplied above height 3·10^12.

records.name: Second moment on the critical line
records.domain: integral of |zeta(1/2+it)|^2 over a long interval
records.quantifiers: T→∞ under the source endpoint convention
records.normalization: classical zeta normalization
records.conclusion: The second moment has main term T log T with the classical lower-order structure.
records.source_locator: classical mean-square theorem; exact lower-order locator retained
records.claim_boundary: Mean values do not imply pointwise zero location.

records.name: Fourth moment on the critical line
records.domain: integral of |zeta(1/2+it)|^4 over a long interval
records.normalization: classical zeta normalization
records.conclusion: The fourth moment has main term (1/(2pi^2))T(log T)^4.
records.claim_boundary: Moment control is an averaged statement and does not exclude isolated off-line zeros.

records.name: Explicit-formula transport interface
records.domain: test functions, prime powers, and nontrivial zeros
records.quantifiers: every test function in a declared admissible class
records.normalization: Mellin/Fourier transform, pole, trivial-zero, and prime-power terms must be fixed
hypotheses: decay and regularity sufficient for the selected explicit formula
records.conclusion: A weighted prime sum equals archimedean, pole, trivial-zero, and nontrivial-zero contributions.
records.source_locator: Bombieri and Titchmarsh interfaces; exact formula selected per use
records.claim_boundary: Deleting any contribution or changing transforms invalidates the bridge.

records.name: Li coefficient criterion
records.domain: Li coefficients of the locked xi function
records.quantifiers: every integer n≥1
records.normalization: lambda_n=(1/(n-1)!) d^n/ds^n [s^{n-1}log xi(s)] at s=1
records.conclusion: RH iff lambda_n≥0 for every n≥1.
records.claim_boundary: Checking finitely many coefficients is finite evidence only.

records.name: Nyman–Beurling–Báez-Duarte approximation criterion
records.domain: closure of fractional-part dilates in L^2(0,infinity)
records.quantifiers: closure over the full declared generating family
records.normalization: rho_a(x)=rho(1/(ax)); parameter and real/complex span convention must be declared
records.conclusion: RH iff the indicator of (0,1) lies in the declared closure; integer dilations suffice in the Báez-Duarte strengthening.
records.claim_boundary: A small finite-dimensional approximation error is not closure membership without a limiting theorem.

records.name: Robin divisor-sum criterion
records.domain: integers n>5040
records.quantifiers: every integer n>5040
records.normalization: sigma(n)=sum_{d|n}d; strict inequality
records.conclusion: RH iff sigma(n)<e^gamma n loglog n for every n>5040.
records.claim_boundary: Finite verification or threshold drift is nonterminal.

records.name: Lagarias harmonic-number criterion
records.domain: positive integers
records.quantifiers: every n≥1
records.normalization: H_n=sum_{k≤n}1/k; equality convention at n=1
records.conclusion: RH iff sigma(n)≤H_n+exp(H_n)log H_n for every n≥1, with equality only at n=1.
records.claim_boundary: Elementary vocabulary does not reduce the universal analytic burden.

records.name: Mertens epsilon-family criterion
records.domain: M(x)=sum_{n≤x}mu(n)
records.quantifiers: for every epsilon>0, uniformly for sufficiently large x with epsilon-dependent constant
records.normalization: O_epsilon(x^(1/2+epsilon))
hypotheses: standard Möbius function and summatory convention
records.conclusion: RH iff M(x)=O_epsilon(x^(1/2+epsilon)) for every epsilon>0.
records.source_locator: classical equivalence; exact theorem locator retained
records.claim_boundary: One fixed epsilon is insufficient; O(sqrt(x)) is a distinct stronger claim.

records.name: Weil explicit-formula positivity criterion
records.domain: a test-function space and its transforms
records.quantifiers: every test function in the exact selected class
records.normalization: transform, involution, convolution, sign, and all explicit-formula terms unresolved in this package
records.conclusion: Under a correct full instantiation, positivity of the associated form is equivalent to RH.
records.source_locator: source route identified; exact theorem contract deferred
records.claim_boundary: Positivity on samples or an unspecified class is not the criterion.

records.name: Riesz and sequential Riesz-like criteria
records.domain: source-defined entire functions or coefficient sequences
records.quantifiers: global asymptotic or full sequence, not finite samples
records.normalization: exact source coefficients, exponent, and simplicity strengthening must be selected
records.conclusion: Certain exact growth or coefficient bounds are equivalent to RH; strengthened rates may encode simplicity.
records.source_locator: Báez-Duarte paper and classical source lineage
records.claim_boundary: Nearby exponents, truncations, or finite coefficient checks are not interchangeable.

records.name: de Bruijn–Newman constant boundary
records.domain: heat-flow deformation H_t of the Riemann xi function
records.quantifiers: all real t under the standard deformation
records.normalization: Rodgers–Tao H_t normalization
records.conclusion: RH is equivalent to Lambda≤0; Rodgers–Tao prove Lambda≥0; hence RH is equivalent to Lambda=0.
records.source_locator: main theorem; upper-bound computation retained as nonterminal context
records.claim_boundary: A numerical upper bound Lambda≤0.22 does not prove Lambda=0.

records.name: Pair-correlation and random-matrix evidence interface
records.domain: scaled spacings of high zeta zeros
records.quantifiers: averaged local statistics under source support and hypothesis profile
records.normalization: mean zero spacing and Fourier support conventions
hypotheses: source-specific assumptions; many formulations assume RH or line zeros
records.conclusion: Partial pair-correlation theorems and GUE predictions describe spacing statistics.
records.claim_boundary: Matching statistics cannot replace proof that every zero lies on the line.

records.name: Hilbert–Pólya sufficient-route contract
records.domain: candidate operator and zeta zero ordinates
records.quantifiers: complete spectrum and every nontrivial zero, with multiplicity
records.normalization: self-adjoint operator on a declared Hilbert space
records.conclusion: A proved exact self-adjoint spectral correspondence would imply RH.
records.claim_boundary: Formal symmetry, PT symmetry, numerical spacing, or a partial spectrum is insufficient.

records.name: Turing-style finite zero-completeness method
records.domain: finite height intervals
records.quantifiers: all zeros in one declared interval
records.normalization: Hardy Z sign/argument data plus an independently bounded zero count
records.conclusion: The listed critical-line zeros are complete in the interval.
records.source_locator: Turing method and modern interval implementation
records.claim_boundary: Completeness in a finite interval does not imply global completeness.
